headlines.text: Rewind to 2025, when the AEW Unified Title was up for grabs as Kazuchika Okada vs. Bandido went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.44 ? a real highlight of the night. Okada dodged a Rainmaker attempt from Bandido before countering with his own to retain the AEW Unified Championship, as a smiling Okada set off tension with Don Callis Family member Takeshita.
Looking back to 2021, when PAC vs. Andrade El Idolo headlined Rampage, rated 8.62 ? a stone-cold classic in a hard-fought men's division clash.
Turning the clock back to 2025: AEW welcomed Sisters Of Sin for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.33.

secondaries.text: On a Wednesday in 2025, back when Briscoe, Cassidy & Strong made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.88.

Flash back to 2025, when The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) vs. The Hurt Syndicate (Trio) fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.09. It was the first title opportunity of The Hurt Syndicate (Trio)'s career.
On this day in 2021, Orange Cassidy vs. Powerhouse Hobbs met in a Tournament Match, getting things started right out of the gate on Rampage, rated 4.88.
